recentItems.title: Ariana Grande Shares Hope Boyfriend Ricky Álvarez Is Her "Last" Love | E! News
recentItems.description:
Ariana Grande is done saying thank u, next. Nearly three weeks after making her romance with Ricky Álvarez Instagram official, the “7 Rings” singer proved she could be in it for good one last time with a cheeky lyric change at the final show of her 'Eternal Sunshine' Tour. Indeed, instead of singing, “Wrote some songs about Ricky / Now I listen and laugh,” while performing “Thank U, Next” at the Sept. 1 concert, Grande sang, “Wrote some songs about Ricky / I’m tryna make him my last.” In video of the moment shared to X, the 33-year-old’s dancers began celebrating the hopeful words as the crowd erupted into cheers. Earlier this summer, Grande spurred speculation that she and Álvarez—who dated between 2015 and 2016—had rekindled their romance when she made other lyric changes to the song, which walks through her past relationships with him, Pete Davidson and Mac Miller. recentItems.title: 'Wheel of Fortune' Announcer Jim Thornton Suspended | E! News
recentItems.description:
'Wheel of Fortune' will have a new announcer for the time being. Sony Pictures Television said it suspended longtime announcer Jim Thornton from the ABC game show after undisclosed allegations were made against him. “We have recently been made aware of allegations concerning Jim Thornton,” a Sony spokesperson said in a Sept. 1 statement to E! News. "He has been suspended from 'Wheel of Fortune' and we are recasting while we conduct a thorough investigation.” While Sony did not provide additional details about the allegations against Thornton, sources with direct knowledge told TMZ the alleged incident involved Thornton and a fellow passenger on an American Airlines flight in May. Without identifying those involved, American Airlines said in a statement to E! News Sept. 1, "On May 14, American Airlines Flight 1276 was met by law enforcement upon arrival at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) following concerns reported by a customer onboard." E! News has reached out to ABC for comment but has not heard back. E! News has not been able to locate contact information for Thornton to seek comment. The new announcer will join the crew two years after host Pat Sajak retired from the series and was replaced by Ryan Seacrest. Vanna White continues to serve as cohost. Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435641/wheel-of-fortune-announcer-jim-thornton-suspended-after-flight-incident

recentItems.title: Justin Baldoni, Candace Owens Pose for Selfie After Chance Meetup | E! News
recentItems.description:
Justin Baldoni and Candace Owens smiled together in a selfie snapped by the conservative political commentator, posted to X Aug. 31. Owens wrote alongside the image with the 'It Ends With Us' star and director, "We asked Claude. There was an approximate 1 in 100 million chance that I ran into Justin Baldoni at an airport in Iceland on a Friday afternoon. Just incredible." Owens has been a vocal defender of Baldoni throughout his legal battle with Blake Lively. Despite the two never having met in person, Owens has repeatedly called Baldoni her "cousin." Lively reached a settlement agreement with Baldoni in May, with a judge recently awarding Lively $407,451.75 in attorney's fees and costs from Baldoni and his partners at Wayfarer Studios. recentItems.title: Jax Taylor Asks Judge for Restraining Order Against Brittany Cartwright Days After Her Filing | E!
recentItems.description:
The contentious divide between Jax Taylor and Brittany Cartwright has grown deeper. Days after Cartwright, 37, was granted a temporary restraining order against Taylor, 47, the original 'Vanderpump Rules' cast member asked a judge to grant no-contact, stay-away and no-abuse orders against his estranged wife, whom he married in 2019. Taylor's Aug. 31 legal request, obtained by E! News, was filed "in opposition to the Request for Domestic Violence Restraining Order filed by Petitioner Brittany Nicole Cartwright," while simultaneously requesting his own domestic violence restraining order. The 'House of Villains' alum (real name Jason Cauchi) contended that his ex's Aug. 27 request should be denied because "her recent allegations describe co-parenting friction and protected responses to her own public attacks, not abuse." Taylor alleged "Since Brittany and I separated in January 2024, she has made me the target of relentless public and private attacks. Within the past six months in particular these attacks have taken on a viciousness that has become intolerable." E! News has reached out to Taylor and Cartwright for comment, but has not yet heard back. recentItems.title: Zendaya Has Stepped Away From Social Media, Her Mom Reveals | E! News
recentItems.description:
On Zendaya’s 30th birthday, her mom Claire Stoermer celebrated by sharing a throwback picture of the Odyssey actress and revealed that her daughter is off social media. “Happy 30th birthday to the love and light of my life!!” Stoermer, who shares Zendaya with ex Kazembe Ajamu Coleman, wrote on Instagram Sept. 1 alongside a throwback picture of the Odyssey star. “Even tho you’re not on socials anymore, and you won’t see this!! we just got off facetime!!” It’s not exactly surprising that the actress is shying away from social media as over the last few years, beyond rare birthday throwbacks, she’s generally used her Instagram to showcase her new movies—and not to mention her jaw-dropping press tour looks. nd over the last year, she has certainly kept busy with films The Drama, Spider-Man: Brand New Day and The Odyssey—with husband Tom Holland joining her for the latter two—not to mention the third and final season of Euphoria all releasing in 2026. As for Dune: Part Three, that film—her third of the year with Robert Pattinson after The Drama and The Odyssey—is set to premiere in December.
